(the “Company”), the proposed holding company for Home Federal Savings and Loan Association of Grand Island, which operates under the name “Home Federal Bank” (the “Bank”), announced today that all final regulatory approvals have been received to complete the Bank’s conversion from the mutual form of organization to the stock form of organization and the Company’s related stock offering. articles.summary: Central Plains Bancshares, Inc. (the “Company”), the holding company for Home Federal Savings and Loan Association of Grand Island, which operates under the name “Home Federal Bank” (the “Bank”), announced today that it has completed the initial public offering in connection with the Bank’s conversion from the mutual form of organization to the stock form of organization. The Company’s common stock is expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol “CPBI” beginning on October 20, 2023. The Company sold 4,130,815 shares of common stock, including 330,465 shares sold to the Bank’s Employee Stock Ownership Plan, and is between the maximum of the offering range and the adjusted maximum of the offering range as disclosed in the Company’s Prospectus dated August 14, 2023.
